compactRecord.n: South Tyrol Museum of Archaeology — Ötzi the Iceman
compactRecord.rs: The actual, real 5,300-year-old man — not a replica — stares back at you through refrigerated glass. The most remarkable preserved human body in the world, with more scientific secrets still being decoded.
compactRecord.td: Archaeological museum in Bolzano opened 1998 to house Ötzi, the 5,300-year-old Copper Age mummy discovered in the Ötztal Alps in 1991. Displayed at −6 °C in a climate-controlled chamber. Copper axe, bow, quiver, and complete kit on display.

compactRecord.n: MMM Firmian — Messner Mountain Museum at Sigmundskron Castle

compactRecord.n: Trauttmansdorff Castle Gardens (Gärten von Schloss Trauttmansdorff)
compactRecord.rs: Where Empress Sisi chose to heal. Tiered gardens with citrus, palms and local wildflowers descend toward Merano below the castle's Neo-Gothic towers — the finest garden experience in the Alps.
